subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **confirm**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Confirm **means to verify or make sure of something. (किसी बात को सत्यापित या सुनिश्चित करना)

 
 
• **For example**: *To confirm its status as a moon, more investigation is necessary.*
 
 
 
• The word "**confirm**" fits in the blank because it indicates the action of verifying or establishing the true identity of an object.
 
• In the context of the sentence, it means that simply spotting an object near a planet is not enough to definitively determine whether it's a moon or an asteroid.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

Complete passage: *Astronomers have discovered 62 new moons orbiting the ringed planet Saturn. Though some of the moons had been (1) spotted __as early as 2019, it takes more than sighting an object close to a planet to (2) **__confirm __**it is a moon and not an asteroid making a brief close passage to that planet.*

*Performing a painstaking (3) ________ of matching objects detected on different nights over the course of 24 months, the team tracked 63 objects that they ended up confirming as moons. One of (4) ________ satellites was revealed back in 2021, with the remaining 62 moons gradually announced over the past few weeks.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sanction**: Official approval or permission for an action, behaviour, or plan. (किसी कार्य, व्यवहार या योजना के लिए आधिकारिक अनुमोदन या अनुमति)
 
• **Consent**: Permission, agreement, or approval given by someone for a particular action or proposal. (किसी विशेष कार्य या प्रस्ताव के लिए किसी द्वारा दी गई अनुमति, सहमति या अनुमोदन)
 
• **Settle**: To resolve, come to an agreement, or find a solution to a dispute, problem, or matter. (किसी विवाद, समस्या या मामले को हल करना, किसी समझौते पर पहुंचना या उसका समाधान ढूंढना)
